board_lot_size.zh: 由发行人自行为其股票确定「整手」（board lot）交易单位，非全市场统一；港交所提供指引（建议整手价值不低于 2,000 港元、股数少于 900,000，并尽量减少碎股）。目前市场在用的整手单位有 40 多种，最常见的是 2,000 股（约 25% 的证券采用）。港交所 2025 年 12 月发布咨询文件，拟将整手单位收敛为 1 / 50 / 100 / 500 / 1,000 / 2,000 / 5,000 / 10,000 股八种标准值（尚未生效）
board_lot_size.en: The board-lot trading unit is set by the issuer for its own stock, not standardised market-wide; HKEX provides guidance (a suggested minimum board-lot value of HK$2,000, a unit of fewer than 900,000 shares, and minimising odd-lot creation). Over 40 distinct board-lot units are currently in use, the most common being 2,000 shares (~25% of securities). In December 2025 HKEX published a consultation proposing to narrow board-lot units to eight standardised values — 1, 50, 100, 500, 1,000, 2,000, 5,000 and 10,000 shares (not yet in effect)
board_lot_size.quote: The current board lot framework allows issuers to determine the board lot unit for their stock. HKEX provides issuers with guidance to assist in selecting appropriate board lot units to support orderly trading and operational efficiency. …… The board lot guidance suggests a minimum board lot value of HK$2,000 …… It also recommends a board lot unit of fewer than 900,000 shares …… issuers would retain flexibility to select their board lot unit but from a defined set of eight standardised board lot units: 1, 50, 100, 500, 1,000, 2,000, 5,000, and 10,000 share(s). …… Standardising board lot sizes from the current structure of over 40 distinct units to a simplified set of eight units would require approximately 25% of issuers to revise their existing board lot structure

odd_lot_handling.zh: 「碎股」（odd lot）= 数量少于一个整手的订单或成交。碎股不被交易系统自动对盘；系统内设特别买卖单位市场（special lot market），交易所参与者把碎股盘挂到指定屏幕由其他参与者撮合，未成交则由卖方经 OTP-C 申报成交。碎股价通常略低于同证券整手价。碎股成交量很低（2025 年上半年占成交笔数 0.2%、成交额 0.1%）；港交所正检讨改进方案
odd_lot_handling.en: An 'odd lot' is an order or trade in a quantity less than one board lot. Odd lots are not auto-matched by the trading system; a special lot market exists in which Exchange Participants post odd-lot orders on a designated screen for matching by other EPs, with the selling party otherwise reporting the trade via OTP-C. Odd-lot prices are usually slightly lower than the board-lot price of the same security. Odd-lot turnover is very low (0.2% of trades and 0.1% of turnover in H1 2025); HKEX is reviewing enhancements
odd_lot_handling.quote: “Odd lot” The quantity of the order or trade that is less than one board lot …… Despite the presence of a semi-automated trade matching mechanism and the manual trade reporting of odd lot transactions, odd lot trading turnover in Hong Kong remains low. …… Odd lot trades represent 0.2% of the total number of trades and 0.1% of the total turnover in the first half of 2025.

监测范围为连续交易时段，但不含早市/午市开始后首15分钟及午市收盘前20分钟。

spec.note: 证券市场（OTP-C 自动对盘）成交视为确定，无美欧式『按价格偏离阈值 + 时限申请复核』的常规错误交易机制。仅在争议经报告、交易所作出决定后方可对参与者交易记录作调整，该决定为最终且不可推翻。香港期货市场 HKATS 另有一套短窗口 Error Trade Rule，本字段不含

error_trade_rule.zh: 证券市场自动对盘的成交为确定成交，没有欧美式『成交价偏离参考价达某百分比、限时申请复核作废』的常规错误交易处理机制。参与者的交易记录只有在争议经报告、并由交易所作出决定后方可调整，且该决定为最终、具决定性并对各方有约束力。（注：香港期货市场另设有一套短窗口的错误交易规则 Error Trade Rule，属期货交易平台 HKATS，不适用于本字段所述的证券市场）
error_trade_rule.en: Automatched trades on the securities market are final; there is no routine erroneous-trade process of the US/EU type (a deviation-from-reference-price threshold plus a time-limited request for review and cancellation). A participant's trading records may be adjusted only after a dispute has been reported and the Exchange has made a decision, and that decision is final and conclusive and binding on the parties. (The Hong Kong futures market has a separate short-window Error Trade Rule on the HKATS platform, which is outside the scope of this securities-market field.)
error_trade_rule.detail: 证券市场：SEHK Rules of the Exchange Rule 567（争议报告后方可调整交易记录、决定为终局）。港交所证券市场没有单独的『明显错误成交』作废流程——这本身是与欧美市场的显著差异。香港期货市场（HKATS）的 Error Trade Rule 为成交后 10 分钟内的窗口。resolution 记 cancel_or_adjust（Rule 567 用『adjustments』措辞）。

error_trade_rule.quote: Any adjustments to a Participant's trading records kept by the Exchange can only be made after a dispute has been reported and a decision made by the Exchange. Any such decision shall be final and conclusive and binding on the parties involved.

Post-trade / large orders: there is no separate dark pool; large trades are reported under the Rules. Trade publication follows the requirements under the Securities and Futures Ordinance

type.zh: 动态价格区间机制：T时段设「動態價格限制機制」（Dynamic Price Banding，浮动区间随参考价移动，当最后成交价偏离参考价超过更新参数时参考价随之调整，用以防止明显错价盘）；T+1（收市後交易）时段另设独立的「價格限制向上/向下機制」（Price Limit Up/Down Mechanism），以T时段即月合约最后成交价为基准的固定百分比区间

main_board.zh: T+1時段（收市后交易）价格上下限：卖盘价不得低于T时段即月合约最后成交价的94%，买盘价不得高于106%（即±6%，适用于指数期货；货币期货为±7%）
main_board.en: T+1 Session price limit: sell orders cannot be priced below 94% and buy orders cannot be priced above 106% of the T Session spot-month contract's last traded price (i.e. ±6% for index futures; ±7% for currency futures)

sources.title: 收市后交易时段 FAQ 中文版（HKEX 官网）

main_board.quote: 在 T+1 時段內，賣盤價不得低於 T 時段現貨月合約最後成交價的94%，而買盤價不得高於 T 時段現貨月合約最後成交價的106%⋯6%（適用於指數期貨）和7%（適用於貨幣期貨）的價限會適時進行檢討。

circuit_breaker.zh: 衍生品市場波動調節機制（VCM）：仅适用于恒生指数、小型恒指、恒生中国企业指数（H股指数）、小型H股指数、恒生科技指数、恒生生物科技指数六个期货品种的现月及次月合约，属逐合约级别而非全市场性质
circuit_breaker.en: Derivatives Market Volatility Control Mechanism (VCM): applies only to the spot-month and next-calendar-month futures contracts of six products — HSI, Mini-HSI, HSCEI (H-shares Index), Mini-HSCEI, Hang Seng TECH Index and Hang Seng Biotech Index futures — i.e. at the individual-contract level, not market-wide
circuit_breaker.detail: 受控词表 `circuit_breaker_type` 目前只有 none/index_level/stock_level/both 四档，均以「股票」为设计语境；本字段的真实颗粒度是「逐合约」（部分期货品种的现月/次月合约），既非严格意义的「指数级」也非「个股级」，这里借用 stock_level 仅取其「非全市场」的含义，不代表真的是个股层面——是裁剪后字段集合复用现货枚举时一处不完全贴合，已记入 OPEN-QUESTIONS「框架性问题」。

sources.title: 衍生产品市场波动调节机制 FAQ 中文版（HKEX 官网）

circuit_breaker.quote: 市調機制僅適用於恒生指數（HSI）期貨，小型恒生指數（MHI）期貨，Ｈ股指數（HHI）期貨，小型Ｈ股指數（MCH）期貨，恒生科技指數（HTI）期貨及恒生生物科技指數（HBI）期貨的首兩個合約月份。

volatility_interruption.zh: 冷靜期觸發條件：期貨合約潛在成交價較5分鐘前最後成交價偏離達±5%即觸發，隨即開始5分鐘冷靜期，期間僅可在價格限制區間內交易；監測適用於持續交易時段，但不包括早市/午市首15分鐘及午市最後20分鐘，亦不適用於開市前議價時段及收市後交易時段
volatility_interruption.en: Cooling-off trigger: when a futures contract's potential trade price deviates ±5% from the last traded price 5 minutes earlier, a 5-minute cooling-off period begins, during which trading is confined within the price band; monitoring applies to the continuous trading session, excluding the first 15 minutes of the morning/afternoon sessions and the last 20 minutes of the afternoon session, and does not apply to the Pre-Market Opening Period or the After-Hours Trading Session

sources.title: 衍生产品市场波动调节机制 FAQ 中文版（HKEX 官网）

volatility_interruption.quote: 一旦期貨合約價格超出5 分鐘前最後一次交易價格的±5%，市調機制將被觸發，並隨即開始 5 分鐘的冷靜期⋯市調機制監測適用於持續交易時段，以下時間除外：早市與午市的首15分鐘、午市的最後20分鐘⋯市調機制適用於正常交易時段而不適用於開市前議價時段及收市後交易時段。

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 短暫停牌機制（THM）：僅適用於收市後交易（T+1）時段的股指期權交易，當買盤最高價達到THM參考價上限或賣盤最低價達到下限（即相應現月期貨於T+1時段的價格限制）時觸發，觸發後該合約於T+1時段餘下時間暫停交易，至下一個T時段恢復
trading_halt_mechanism.en: Trading Halt Mechanism (THM): applies only to equity index options trading in the After-Hours Trading (T+1) Session; triggered when the highest bid reaches the upper THM reference price or the lowest ask reaches the lower THM reference price (i.e. the T+1 Session price limit of the corresponding spot-month futures contract); once triggered, the contract halts for the remainder of the T+1 Session and resumes trading in the next T Session

sources.title: 收市后交易时段 FAQ 中文版（HKEX 官网）

trading_halt_mechanism.quote: 短暫停牌機制只適用於T+1時段的期權交易。只有在參考合約 (即月期貨) 的現存買盤價(賣盤價)達短暫停牌機制參考價以上(以下)的5%時，短暫停牌機制才會被觸發。一旦短暫停牌機制被觸發，該短暫停牌的期權合約於剩餘 T+1時段的交易亦會暫停⋯股票指數期權合約的交易將於下一個 T 時段恢復。

block_trade.zh: T及T+1時段均设大手交易安排（Block Trade Facility）；T+1時段大手交易须同样遵守当時段±6%/±7%的價格上下限，並適用特別大手交易按金（Special Block Trade Margin, SBTM）；因T+1時段並無銀行支援，若相關參與者抵押品不足以達到SBTM要求，大手交易及/或相關買賣調整會被拒絕
block_trade.en: Block Trade Facility is available in both the T and T+1 Sessions; T+1 Session block trades are subject to the same ±6%/±7% price limit and Special Block Trade Margin (SBTM); as there is no banking support during T+1, block trades or related trade adjustments will be rejected if collateral is insufficient to meet the SBTM
block_trade.detail: 以上信息来自收市后交易时段（AHT）FAQ 页对大手交易机制的旁及说明；导航栏可见的专门 Block Trade Facility 规则页本次未抓取，可能载有最小交易量等更完整的门槛信息，留待后续补充，confidence 因此标 medium 而非 high。

sources.title: 收市后交易时段 FAQ 中文版（HKEX 官网）

block_trade.quote: 收市後交易時段的大手交易機制的交易安排與T時段相同，除了：大手交易價亦須符合T+1時段+/-6%的價格上下限規定；及特別大手交易按金會如常適用⋯由於T+1時段並無銀行支援，若相關參與者CCMS抵押品戶口的抵押品不足以達到特別大手交易按金的金額，大手交易及／或相關買賣調整會被拒絕。

market_maker_scheme.zh: 香港交易所衍生產品市場內的不同產品均設有市場莊家計劃及/或流通量提供者計劃：股票期貨、股指期貨及期權的莊家責任及獎勵已闡述於期交所規則內；股票期權的莊家責任及獎勵則闡述於聯交所期權交易規則；莊家分主要莊家（PMM）、持續報價莊家（CQMM）、回應詢價莊家（QRMM）三類；流通量提供者計劃（LP）是交易所為新產品流通量所作的商業安排，要求及獎勵較具彈性，不寫入交易所規則
market_maker_scheme.en: HKEX's derivatives market has both a Market Maker (MM) Program and/or a Liquidity Provider (LP) Program depending on the product: MM obligations/incentives for futures and index options are set out in the HKFE Rules; for stock options, in SEHK's Options Trading Rules. Three MM categories: Primary Market Maker (PMM), continuous-quote market maker (CQMM), and quote-request-response market maker (QRMM). The LP Program is a more flexible commercial arrangement for new products' liquidity, not codified in exchange rules.

sources.title: 衍生品市场做市商计划中文版（HKEX 官网）

market_maker_scheme.quote: 香港交易所衍生產品市場內的不同產品均設有市場莊家計劃及或流通量提供者計劃。股票期貨、股指期貨及期權市場莊家計劃的責任及獎勵已闡述於期交所規則內；至於股票期權市場莊家計劃的責任及獎勵則闡述於期權交易規則⋯聯交所中。流通量提供者計劃是交易所與委任的流通量提供者為提供新產品流通量而作出的商業安排，其要求及獎勵可較具彈性並不會強制闡述於交易所的規則內。

margin_practice_note.zh: 結算所（期貨結算公司HKCC／聯交所期權結算所SEOCH）收取按金，是其用以減輕日後面對結算對手信貸風險的主要工具：按金要求透過評估個別期貨或期權合約又或組合在16個模擬情況下的單日最高潛在虧損，再按所設置信水平計算所得；具体算式採用組合風險按金系統 PRiME（Portfolio Risk Margining System，SPAN兼容），由DCASS用以計算期貨及期權產品的結算所按金；客戶按金＝結算所按金 × 客戶按金乘數（提增比例）
margin_practice_note.en: The clearing houses (HKFE Clearing Corporation, HKCC, and SEHK Options Clearing House, SEOCH) collect margin as their main tool to mitigate future credit exposure to counterparties: margin requirement is calculated based on the maximum potential loss of a futures/options contract or portfolio over a one-day period under 16 simulated scenarios at a defined confidence level. The methodology used is PRiME (Portfolio Risk Margining System), a SPAN-compatible algorithm applied in DCASS to calculate margin requirements for futures and options products; client margin equals the clearing house margin scaled up by a client margin multiplier.

sources.title: 衍生品结算风险管理／保证金中文版（HKEX 官网）

margin_practice_note.quote: 結算所收取按金，是其用以減輕日後面對結算對手的信貸風險的主要工具。具體的按金要求，是透過評估個別期貨或期權合約又或期貨期權合約組合在16個不同的模擬情況下的單日最高潛在虧損，再加上所界設定置信水平計算所得⋯期貨結算公司及聯交所期權結算所的組合風險按金系統（PRiME）屬於SPAN相容的按金算式，是DCASS用以計算期貨及期權產品按金要求的按金計算方法⋯客戶按金應按照結算所風險系數檔案計算，再按一個乘數提增按金。

connect_schemes.detail: 本次抓取的官方页面未见衍生品市场（HKATS 挂牌期货期权）本身有类似证券市场沪港通/深港通的南北向互联互通安排。HKEX集团另设「互換通」（Swap Connect），但那是场外利率掉期业务（OTC Clear业务线，非本子块讨论的HKATS挂牌衍生品），与顶层字段裁剪而来的「挂牌衍生品互联互通」语境不是同一件事，不应混填，如实留空，记入 OPEN-QUESTIONS。

boards.financial_threshold: 三选一（均另需上市时预期市值≥HK$5亿，其中由公众持有部分≥HK$1.25亿，见《上市规则》8.09条）：①盈利测试（8.05(1)条）——三年营业记录，最近一年股东应占盈利≥HK$3,500万，前两年累计≥HK$4,500万；②市值/收益/现金流量测试（8.05(2)条）——三年营业记录，上市时市值≥HK$20亿，最近一年经审计收益≥HK$5亿，前三年经营现金流入合计≥HK$1亿；③市值/收益测试（8.05(3)条）——三年营业记录，上市时市值≥HK$40亿，最近一年经审计收益≥HK$5亿

二选一（均另需上市时预期市值≥HK$1.5亿，见《GEM上市规则》11.23(6)条；2024年1月GEM改革后现行标准）：①现金流量测试（11.12A(1)条）——两年营业记录，前两年经营现金流入合计≥HK$3,000万；②市值/收益/研发测试（11.12A(4)条）——两年营业记录，上市时市值≥HK$2.5亿，前两年收益合计≥HK$1亿且按年增长，前两年研发开支合计≥HK$3,000万，且各年研发开支须占总营运开支≥15%

review_system.en: Disclosure-based regime (not a simple registration/merit-review dichotomy — the Listing Committee retains substantive discretion over suitability for listing)

spec.note: 监管机构各自最多 40 个营业日确认有否重大监管关注（合资格 A 股上市公司加速为 30）；申请人及保荐人回应约 60 个营业日；整体在六个月申请有效期内完成

listing_process_duration.zh: 2024年10月18日起证监会与港交所推行「优化后申请时限」：申请材料一次性符合全部适用规定的个案，两个监管机构各自最多经两轮监管意见后，须在不超过40个营业日内确认有否重大监管关注；申请人及保荐人配合处理意见通常另需约60个营业日，整个审批流程预期在六个月申请有效期内完成；符合资格的A股上市公司可适用加速审批时限，缩短为30个营业日（较标准40个营业日快）
listing_process_duration.en: Since 18 October 2024, under the SFC/HKEX Enhanced Application Timeframe, for applications that fully meet requirements, each regulator will confirm whether there are material regulatory concerns within a maximum of 40 business days after at most two rounds of regulatory comments; applicants and sponsors are expected to take a total of around 60 business days to address comments, with the whole process expected to complete within the six-month application validity window; eligible A-share listed companies qualify for an Accelerated Timeframe of 30 business days (instead of 40)
listing_process_duration.detail: 本条为「预期时限」而非法定强制期限——联合声明原文用词是expected/will，附注说明该40营业日计算的是监管机构手上的天数，不含申请人回复所占用的时间。

sources.title: Joint Statement on Enhanced Timeframe for New Listing Application Process（HKEX/SFC联合声明）

listing_process_duration.quote: the time taken by each regulator to confirm whether there are any material regulatory concerns will be no more than 40 business days ... The applicant and its sponsor are expected to take a total of around 60 business days to satisfactorily address regulators’ comments. Subject to obtaining approvals from the Listing Committee and other authorities or regulators, the application process would be completed within the six-month application validity window. ... Under the Accelerated Timeframe ... 30 business days (instead of 40 business days).

continuing_obligations.zh: 《主板上市规则》第13章：发行人自证券获批上市起须持续遵守《上市规则》，董事共同及个别负责确保发行人全面合规；核心是维持公平有序市场及信息同时对称披露，第13.05条明确交易所根据《证券及期货条例》第21条负有确保市场有序、知情、公平的法定职责，发行人及其董事另按《证券及期货条例》「内幕消息条文」承担披露内幕消息的法定责任；违反持续责任除可能触发纪律处分外，交易所亦可动用暂停或撤销上市地位的权力
continuing_obligations.en: Main Board Listing Rules Chapter 13: an issuer must comply with the Listing Rules on an ongoing basis once its securities are admitted to listing, with directors collectively and individually responsible for ensuring full compliance. The continuing obligations are primarily to maintain a fair and orderly market and simultaneous access to information; Rule 13.05 confirms the Exchange's statutory duty under section 21 of the SFO to ensure an orderly, informed and fair market, and issuers/directors separately bear statutory duties to disclose inside information under the SFO's Inside Information Provisions; breach of a continuing obligation may lead to disciplinary action in addition to the Exchange's power to suspend or cancel a listing
continuing_obligations.detail: 本条来源为 HKEX 官网托管的 Chapter 13 PDF，本次未找到对应中文整合页（cn-rules.hkex.com.hk 未见 Chapter 13 独立条目），quote 为英文原文，zh 为忠实翻译，非逐字对照中文官方文本。

sources.title: Chapter 13 EQUITY SECURITIES CONTINUING OBLIGATIONS（HKEX官网PDF）

continuing_obligations.quote: 13.03 The continuing obligations in this Chapter are primarily to ensure the maintenance of a fair and orderly market in securities and that all users of the market have simultaneous access to the same information. Failure by an issuer to comply with a continuing obligation may result in the Exchange taking disciplinary action in addition to its power to suspend or cancel a listing. 13.04 An issuer’s directors are collectively and individually responsible for ensuring the issuer’s full compliance with the Listing Rules.

suspension_resumption.zh: 停牌须由发行人或其授权代表/财务顾问向交易所提出申请并附具体理由；交易所拥有酌情决定权，仅在认为理由充分时才批准停牌，否则倾向要求发行人改以公告澄清；停牌/停牌期间应为绝对必要的最短时间，发行人有责任确保在适当公告刊发后尽快复牌；复牌方向由交易所指示，可要求发行人先刊发复牌公告，其后交易所才指示恢复交易；若停牌拖延且发行人未采取足够行动争取复牌，可能导致交易所进一步启动撤销上市程序
suspension_resumption.en: A trading halt or suspension request must be made to the Exchange by the issuer or its authorised representative/financial adviser, supported by specific reasons; the Exchange has discretion and will only accept the request if the reasons given warrant it, otherwise it will normally expect a clarifying announcement instead; any halt or suspension should be for the shortest possible period, and it is the issuer's responsibility to ensure trading resumes as soon as practicable after an appropriate announcement; the Exchange directs resumption, which may require the issuer to publish a resumption announcement first; prolonged suspension without adequate remedial action by the issuer may lead the Exchange to proceed towards cancellation of listing
suspension_resumption.detail: 本条摘引自 GEM 上市规则第六章「Trading Halt, Suspension, Cancellation and Withdrawal of Listing」Entire Section 合并页，主板对应条文为《主板上市规则》第九章，两板机制结构一致，本次以能grep到完整正文的GEM章节为准；quote为英文原文（该entiresection页面本身即为英文版规则手册）。

sources.title: Trading halt or suspension - Entire Section（GEM上市规则第六章，Rulebook合并页）

suspension_resumption.quote: Any request for a trading halt or suspension must be made to the Exchange by the issuer or its authorised representative or financial adviser and must be supported by the specific reasons which the issuer wishes the Exchange to take into account ... The duration of any trading halt or suspension should be for the shortest possible period. It is the issuer's responsibility to ensure that trading in its securities resumes as soon as practicable following the publication of an appropriate announcement ... The Exchange shall have the power to direct the resumption of trading of halted or suspended securities.

delisting_process.zh: 《主板上市规则》第6.01/6.01A(1)/6.10条：就已触发退市条件的发行人，交易所可(a)发出退市通知并订明补救期限（remedial period），若发行人未能在期限届满前补救问题并恢复交易，交易所可撤销其上市地位；或(b)在触发退市条件的事项属根本性且无法补救的例外情况下直接撤销上市；若6.01与6.01A(1)两条同时可适用，交易所倾向按6.01订立较短的「特定补救期限」（specific remedial period，例如6个月），而非套用18个月的「订明补救期限」（prescribed remedial period）
delisting_process.en: Main Board Listing Rules 6.01/6.01A(1)/6.10: for an issuer that has triggered a delisting criterion, the Exchange may (a) issue a delisting notice specifying a remedial period — if the issuer fails to remedy the issues and resume trading before the period ends, the Exchange may cancel its listing; or (b) delist the issuer immediately, only in exceptional circumstances where the triggering matters are fundamental and beyond remedy; where both Rule 6.01 and 6.01A(1) apply, the Exchange will tend to impose a shorter specific remedial period under Rule 6.10 (e.g. 6 months) rather than the 18-month prescribed remedial period
delisting_process.detail: 本条与 delisting_transition_period 共用同一份来源文件（GL95-18指引信），前者说明程序本身，后者聚焦补救期限的具体时长与延期规则，避免重复摘引同一段落。

delisting_process.quote: Under Rule 6.10 which sets out the procedures for delisting an issuer under Rule 6.01, the Exchange may, (a) issue a delisting notice specifying a remedial period (specific remedial period). If the issuer fails to remedy the issues and resume trading before the end of the remedial period, the Exchange may cancel its listing; or (b) delist the issuer immediately. ... The Exchange may delist an issuer immediately under Rule 6.01 only in exceptional circumstances where the matters triggering the application of a delisting criterion are fundamental to the general principles for listing and are beyond remedy.

delisting_transition_period.zh: 强制除牌前的「补救期限」（remedial period）：按《主板上市规则》6.01A(1)条，发行人自停牌之日起18个月内（「订明补救期限」）仍未补救导致停牌的问题并恢复交易，交易所可将其除牌；交易所亦可按6.10条为个案酌情订立更短的「特定补救期限」（如6个月）；补救期限届满时若获批延期，一般不会再获第二次延期
delisting_transition_period.en: The remedial period before mandatory delisting: under Main Board Listing Rule 6.01A(1), the Exchange may delist a suspended issuer that fails to remedy the issues causing its suspension and resume trading within 18 months from the date the suspension begins (the prescribed remedial period); the Exchange may instead impose a shorter specific remedial period under Rule 6.10 on a case-by-case basis (e.g. 6 months); if an extension is granted upon expiry of the remedial period, the Listing Committee would not normally extend it a second time

post_delisting_venue.zh: 香港目前没有承接已除牌证券交易的场外（OTC）替代平台——港交所2025年8月发表的咨询总结文件确认，设立此类OTC市场仍在与市场持份者商讨可行性阶段、尚未落地；文件将「为已除牌发行人股东提供退出机会」列为设立OTC市场若干潜在效益之一，反面印证现状下退市股东缺乏交易所层面的退出渠道
post_delisting_venue.en: Hong Kong currently has no over-the-counter (OTC) alternative platform for trading delisted securities — HKEX's August 2025 consultation conclusions confirm that establishing such an OTC market remains under discussion with stakeholders on feasibility and has not yet been implemented; the paper lists 'providing an exit opportunity for shareholders of delisted issuers' as one potential benefit of an OTC market, which by implication confirms delisted shareholders currently lack an exchange-level exit channel

default_management.zh: 以 HKCC（期货结算公司）为例：结算所设立结算所违约管理执行小组（DMEG，由 HKEX 集团首席风险官、首席营运官等高层组成）统筹违约处置，委任特定结算参与者作为「获授权经纪商」协助平仓/对冲/拍卖违约方持仓，每年进行违约演习并至少每年检讨《违约管理手册》；损失分摊按《期货结算公司规则》706条设定的「违约损失分摊阶梯」（default waterfall）依次动用：①违约方自身向结算基金（RF）的出资；②授予违约方的可变出资信用额；③RF累计利息收入；④保险赔付（目前未有相关保险安排）；⑤结算所自身拨入RF的资源；⑥非违约参与者的固定出资；⑦担保或信贷安排所得；⑧非违约参与者的可变出资及可变出资信用额（按比例分摊）
default_management.en: Using HKCC (HKFE Clearing Corporation) as the example: HKEX has established a Default Management Executive Group (DMEG, comprising senior executives including HKEX Group's chief risk officer and chief operating officer) to manage the default process, appoints designated Clearing Participants as "authorised brokers" to assist in closing-out, hedging and auctioning a defaulter's positions, conducts annual default drills, and reviews the Default Management Manual at least annually. Loss allocation follows the default waterfall under HKFE Clearing Corporation Rule 706, applied in order: (1) the defaulter's own Reserve Fund (RF) contributions; (2) Variable Contribution Credit granted to the defaulter; (3) RF accumulated interest income; (4) proceeds of any insurance policies (none currently arranged); (5) HKCC's own resources appropriated to the RF; (6) Fixed Contributions of non-defaulting Participants; (7) proceeds of any guarantees or facilities arranged; and (8) Variable Contributions and Variable Contribution Credits of non-defaulting Participants on a pro-rata basis
default_management.detail: 现货市场（HKSCC/CCASS）另设结构相近的「保证基金」（Guarantee Fund，《香港中央结算通用规则》第25章，最低现金基本出资额每名直接结算参与者5万港元或每持有一个联交所交易权5万港元，以较高者为准），本次未逐条摘引其独立瀑布顺序，二者原理相近但规则条文各自独立，如需精确比较现货/衍生品两套违约处置机制的顺序差异，应分别摘引 HKSCC 通用规则第25章与本字段引用的 HKCC 规则706条，本条暂以衍生品/HKCC一侧为代表性样本。

default_management.quote: HKEX has established a Default Management Executive Group (DMEG), comprising senior executives from various divisions of HKEX including HKEX group chief risk officer and chief operating officer, to manage the default management process. ... HKCC conducts default drills annually with the DMEG. ... Under HKCC Rule 706, the order of application of the RF is as follows: (a) RF contributions (including Fixed Contribution and Variable Contribution) of the defaulting HKCC Participant; (b) Variable Contribution Credit granted to the defaulting HKCC Participant; (c) RF accumulated interest income; (d) the proceeds of any insurance policies arranged [Currently there is no insurance arrangement]; (e) the resources of HKCC appropriated to the RF; (f) the Fixed Contributions made by all non-defaulting HKCC Participants; (g) the proceeds of any guarantees or facilities arranged; and (h) the Variable Contributions and Variable Contribution Credits of all non-defaulting HKCC Participants on a pro-rata basis.

initial_margin_practice.zh: 结算所（HKCC）以组合风险按金系统 PRiME（SPAN兼容）每日两次计算结算所按金要求：基于对单一期货/期权合约或组合在16个模拟市场情景、既定置信水平下、一日风险边际期（margin period of risk）内的最大潜在亏损进行评估；若任何HKCC产品的结算所按金于正常交易时段内被侵蚀达25%，另触发临时性的日间按金（IDM）追缴；实物交收合约于最后结算日前另加收现货月按金/实物交收合约按金以缓释交收风险
initial_margin_practice.en: The clearing house (HKCC) calculates CH Margin requirements twice daily using the Portfolio Risk Management System (PRiME, SPAN-compatible), based on an assessment of the maximum potential loss of a futures/options contract or portfolio over a one-day margin period of risk under 16 simulated market scenarios at a defined confidence level; an ad hoc intra-day margin (IDM) call is also triggered when CH Margin erosion of 25% occurs in any HKCC product during normal trading sessions; a spot month/physical delivery contract charge is additionally imposed prior to the final settlement day of physically settled contracts to mitigate delivery risk

sources.title: HKCC（期货结算公司）PFMI 信息披露文件（2025年2月版）

initial_margin_practice.quote: To cover its future credit exposure, HKCC calculates the CH Margin requirements of HKCC Participants twice daily using the Portfolio Risk Management System of HKEX ("PRiME") based on its assessment of the maximum potential losses of a futures or an options contract or a portfolio of futures and options contracts over the margin period of risk (currently one day) under 16 simulated market scenarios and a defined confidence level. Ad hoc intra-day margin (IDM) will also be triggered when there is a CH Margin erosion of 25% in any HKCC product during normal trading sessions.

maintenance_margin_practice.zh: 结算所（HKCC）不采用固定「维持保证金」门槛的表述，而是以「日间按金（IDM）」机制动态追补：正常交易时段内任何HKCC产品的结算所按金一旦被市场波动侵蚀达25%，即时触发临时追缴，不待日终盯市；另就HKCC参与者在单一产品组按结算基金压力测试假设计算的净预计亏损（Net Projected Loss）超过全体参与者净预计亏损总额30%、且该产品组净预计亏损总额超过5亿港元时，加征集中风险按金（Concentration Risk Margin）
maintenance_margin_practice.en: HKCC does not use a fixed "maintenance margin" threshold; instead it tops up dynamically via intra-day margin (IDM): an ad hoc call is triggered immediately, without waiting for end-of-day mark-to-market, whenever CH Margin erosion of 25% occurs in any HKCC product during normal trading sessions; HKCC also imposes Concentration Risk Margin on a Participant when its Net Projected Loss in a product group (based on Reserve Fund stress assumptions) exceeds 30% of all Participants' total Net Projected Loss and the product group's total Net Projected Loss exceeds HK$500 million

sources.title: HKCC（期货结算公司）PFMI 信息披露文件（2025年2月版）

maintenance_margin_practice.quote: Ad hoc intra-day margin (IDM) will also be triggered when there is a CH Margin erosion of 25% in any HKCC product during normal trading sessions. ... HKCC also imposes Concentration Risk Margin on an HKCC Participant if the projected aggregate loss (less any CH Margin) of that HKCC Participant in any product group based on the Reserve Fund (RF) stress assumptions (Net Projected Loss) is greater than 30% of the total Net Projected Loss of all HKCC Participants and the total Net Projected Loss of the product group concerned is in excess of HK$500 million.

mark_to_market_frequency.zh: 每日两次盯市：所有期货/期权未平仓合约按各自结算价盯市，计算每个结算账户的浮动盈亏（VA），分别于T时段（正常交易时段）与收市后交易（AHT）时段结束后各计算一次
mark_to_market_frequency.en: Twice daily: all open futures/options positions are marked to market based on their respective settlement prices to calculate the variation adjustment (VA) for each Clearing Account, once after the end of the normal (T) trading session and once after the After-hours Trading (AHT) session

mark_to_market_frequency.quote: All outstanding positions resulting from Market Contracts are marked to market and subject to margin calculation on daily basis. ... To cover its current credit exposure, HKCC marks all open positions to market based on their respective settlement prices to calculate the VA for each Clearing Account. The VA calculation is conducted twice daily after the end of the normal trading session and the After-hours Trading (AHT) session.

last_trading_day_rule.zh: 因产品而异，无统一规则：以股票期货为例，最后交易日为合约月份的倒数第二个交易日，最后结算日为最后交易日后第一个交易日，最终结算价采相关股票在最后交易日港交所（SEHK）官方收市价；恒生指数系列期货/期权则以「到期日」（Expiry Day）表述——合约月份第三个星期五（如非交易日则顺延至前一交易日），到期日下午收市前另设官方结算价计算窗口
last_trading_day_rule.en: Varies by product, with no single unified rule: for Stock Futures, the Last Trading Day is the second-last Trading Day of the Contract Month and the Final Settlement Day is the first Trading Day after it, with the Final Settlement Price being the underlying stock's official SEHK closing price on the Last Trading Day; the HSI-series index futures/options instead use "Expiry Day" — the third Friday of the Contract Month (or the preceding Trading Day if that is not a Trading Day) — with an official settlement-price calculation window before close on the Expiry Day
last_trading_day_rule.detail: 两类产品官方页面各自使用「Last Trading Day」（个股期货）与「Expiry Day」（恒指系列期货期权）两套不同术语描述功能相同的概念，本字段综合两份产品页说明，未强行统一措辞，以免掩盖港交所自身产品文档间的实际用词差异。

account_opening_requirements.zh: 证监会《持牌人或注册人操守准则》第5.1段：证监会认可两类开户核实方式——「面对面」（开户文件在持牌人/注册人雇员在场情况下签立）与「非面对面」（客户协议书签署及身份文件核对须由持牌/注册人士、其联属机构、太平绅士，或银行经理/执业会计师/律师/公证人/特许秘书等专业人士见证核实）；非面对面开户亦可通过「电子支票认证」（客户签立协议书+身份文件+以本人名义在香港持牌银行账户开立支票核实签名一致）或「iAM Smart」数字身份认证完成
account_opening_requirements.en: SFC Code of Conduct paragraph 5.1: the SFC recognises two account opening verification approaches — "Face-to-face" (documents executed in the presence of a licensed/registered person's employee) and "Non-face-to-face" (the client agreement and identity documents must instead be certified by another licensed/registered person, an affiliate, a Justice of the Peace, or a professional such as a bank branch manager, certified public accountant, lawyer, notary public or chartered secretary); non-face-to-face opening can also be completed via a "cheque authentication" process (client sends a signed client agreement plus identity document, then a cheque drawn on their own Hong Kong bank account to verify the signature) or via the "iAM Smart" digital identity service

sources.title: Acceptable account opening approaches（SFC官网）

account_opening_requirements.quote: For the purposes of paragraph 5.1 of the Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission (Code of Conduct), the SFC considers the following account opening approaches acceptable: Face-to-face / The account opening documents are executed in the presence of an employee of the licensed or registered person. Non-face-to-face / Where the account opening documents are not executed in the presence of an employee of the licensed or registered person, the signing of the client agreement ... and sighting of related identity documents should be certified by any other licensed or registered person, an affiliate of a licensed or registered person, a JP (Justice of the Peace), or a professional person such as a branch manager of a bank, certified public accountant, lawyer, notary public or chartered secretary

suitability_management.en: The Suitability Requirement is set out in Paragraph 5.2 of the Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC). It requires a licensed or registered person to, when making a recommendation or solicitation, ensure the suitability of the recommendation or solicitation for the client is reasonable in all the circumstances, having regard to information about the client of which the licensed or registered person is or should be aware through the exercise of due diligence. It is officially described as the cornerstone of investor protection, applies to any distribution/advisory channel (including online platforms), and is accompanied by SFC guidance on product due diligence and disclosure of monetary benefits

spec.note: 未取得「明确不征」的正面依据：本次抓取的 IRD 印花税页只讲印花税本身及其减免，未逐字排除「印花税之外的独立证券交易税」；港交所费率页只列自身收费。香港证券买卖的从价交易税负体现为印花税（见 costs.stamp_duty，交易双方各 0.1%），另有代收代缴的证监会/会财局征费（见 costs.regulatory_fees）——业界普遍理解为「无独立于印花税的 FTT」，但缺一手正面陈述，按 CLAUDE.md 二.4 记 rate: null（幽灵条）而非 type: none，见 OPEN-QUESTIONS

financial_transaction_tax.zh: 香港是否另立独立于印花税之外的「金融交易税」税目，本次未取得正面依据：IRD 印花税页只讲印花税及其减免、未逐字排除其他证券交易税，港交所费率页只列自身收费。证券买卖的从价交易税负体现为印花税（见 costs.stamp_duty，交易双方各 0.1%），另有代收代缴性质的证监会/会计及财务汇报局征费（见 costs.regulatory_fees），两者功能上合计构成港股的交易税费负担；业界普遍理解港股无独立于印花税的 FTT，但港交所/税务局官方材料均未作此正面陈述。按 CLAUDE.md 第二节第四条，spec 记为 rate: null（幽灵条）而非 type: none，并转 OPEN-QUESTIONS
financial_transaction_tax.en: Whether Hong Kong has a separately-named "financial transaction tax" distinct from stamp duty was not positively established: the IRD Stamp Duty page only addresses stamp duty itself and its reliefs, without a verbatim exclusion of any other securities transaction tax, and the HKEX fee page only lists HKEX's own charges. The ad valorem transaction tax burden on securities trading is expressed as Stamp Duty (see costs.stamp_duty, 0.1% each side) plus the pass-through SFC/AFRC levies (see costs.regulatory_fees); it is widely understood that Hong Kong has no FTT separate from stamp duty, but neither HKEX nor the Inland Revenue Department states this positively. Per the CLAUDE.md anti-hallucination rules the spec is recorded as rate: null (ghost bar) rather than type: none and referred to OPEN-QUESTIONS.
financial_transaction_tax.detail: 结构性判断（该税目在港疑未独立存在）而非某个具体数值。2026-09-01 复核：抓到 IRD 印花税页（ird.gov.hk/eng/tax/sdu.htm），但其内容是印花税制度与减免，不构成「除印花税外无证券交易税」的正面依据；此前一度据此翻 type: none，收尾审查（ADR-058）判定引文不支撑结论，回退 rate: null。翻 type: none 需 IRD/库务署明确「证券交易税负即印花税、别无他税」的一手陈述。

dividend_withholding_tax.zh: 香港利得税制度下，已缴付香港利得税的法团所分派的股息，在计算应评税利润时予以豁免（不计入应课税利润）；《税务条例》未设有股息预扣税条款，与利得税豁免条文合并推断港股股息不适用预扣税
dividend_withholding_tax.en: Under the Profits Tax regime, dividends distributed by a corporation that has already paid Hong Kong Profits Tax are excluded from assessable profits (exempt); the Inland Revenue Ordinance contains no dividend withholding tax provision, and combined with the profits-tax exemption clause this supports the conclusion that HKEX-listed dividends are not subject to withholding tax
dividend_withholding_tax.detail: 税务局官网原文只直接确认『豁免应评税利润』这一条文，未见页面正面使用『不设预扣税』的措辞；『无股息预扣税』是从该豁免条文+《税务条例》通篇未见预扣税条款两点合并推断得出，非逐字摘引的正面陈述，confidence 因此定 medium 而非 high。

implicit_costs_note.zh: 港交所2024年6月发表的最小价差检讨咨询文件官方确认：港股买卖价差（bid-ask spread，隐性交易成本之一）水平相对国际同类市场偏高；文件由香港特区政府2023年8月成立的「促进股票市场流动性专责小组」建议推动，提出分阶段调整最小价差以缩窄买卖价差——第一阶段（$10-$50价格带）拟降低最小价差50%-60%，第二阶段（$0.5-$10价格带）拟降低50%
implicit_costs_note.en: HKEX's June 2024 consultation paper on minimum spread reform officially confirms that Hong Kong's bid-ask spread (one component of implicit trading cost) is relatively higher than the average of international peer markets; the reform was recommended by the Task Force on Enhancing Stock Market Liquidity set up by the HKSAR Government in August 2023, proposing a phased reduction of minimum spreads to narrow bid-ask spreads — Phase 1 (price bands $10-$50) proposes a 50%-60% reduction, Phase 2 (price bands $0.5-$10) proposes a 50% reduction

sources.title: Consultation Paper June 2024《Proposed Reduction of Minimum Spreads in the Securities Market》

implicit_costs_note.quote: The spread cost as represented by the bid-ask spread is one of the implicit transaction costs, thus minimum spread is considered to impact transaction cost and trading liquidity. ... The spread cost when trading securities on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (the “Exchange”) is relatively higher than the average of international peer markets, and reducing minimum spread is one way to help lower this cost. ... a reduction of minimum spreads ... Phase 1 will cover price bands between $10 and $50 and it is proposed to reduce the minimum spreads by 50% - 60%; while in phase 2, the minimum spread of the price band of $0.5 - $10 is proposed to be reduced by 50%.

regulatory_change_risk_note.zh: 香港上市/交易制度近年处于活跃调整期，官方样本包括：①2023年6月19日推出港元-人民币双柜台模式（Dual Counter Model）及双柜台做市商计划；②2023年3月31日《上市规则》新增第18C章「特专科技公司」上市规则，2024年8月23日证监会与港交所联合公布为期三年（至2027年8月31日）的临时性宽免措施；③2024年10月18日起证监会与港交所推行「优化后申请时限」，为新上市申请审批设定更明确的监管意见轮次与时限；④2024年6月港交所就下调最小价差（买卖价差改革）展开市场咨询
regulatory_change_risk_note.en: Hong Kong's listing/trading regime has been in a period of active reform in recent years, with official examples including: (1) the HKD-RMB Dual Counter Model and Dual Counter Market Making Programme launched on 19 June 2023; (2) new Chapter 18C 'Specialist Technology Companies' listing rules effective 31 March 2023, with the SFC and HKEX jointly announcing temporary relief measures for a fixed three-year period (to 31 August 2027) on 23 August 2024; (3) the SFC/HKEX Enhanced Application Timeframe for new listing applications, effective 18 October 2024, setting clearer regulatory-comment rounds and deadlines; and (4) HKEX's June 2024 market consultation on reducing minimum spreads (bid-ask spread reform)

enforcement_note.zh: 香港市场执法为多轨并行架构：①上市规则层面——港交所上市部下设「上市监管及执法科」负责调查违反《上市规则》的行为并按需采取纪律处分，可动用暂停/撤销上市地位等权力；②持牌中介人层面——证监会根据《证券及期货条例》第九部对持牌法团、注册机构及其负责人员/主管行使纪律处分权（谴责、罚款、暂缓/撤销牌照等）；③此外证监会亦可就市场失当行为（内幕交易、虚假交易、操纵股价等）诉诸市场失当行为审裁处，或提请刑事检控（裁判法院）及民事诉讼（高等法院），四条执法路径彼此独立、互不替代
enforcement_note.en: Hong Kong market enforcement is a multi-track architecture: (1) at the Listing Rules level, HKEX's Listing Regulation and Enforcement Department investigates possible Listing Rule breaches and takes disciplinary action as needed, including the power to suspend or cancel a listing; (2) at the licensed-intermediary level, the SFC exercises disciplinary powers under Part IX of the SFO over licensed corporations, registered institutions and their responsible officers/executives (reprimand, fines, licence suspension/revocation, etc.); (3) the SFC may separately pursue market misconduct (insider dealing, false trading, price rigging, etc.) before the Market Misconduct Tribunal, or pursue criminal prosecution (Magistrates' Court) or civil proceedings (High Court) — these four enforcement tracks are independent of one another and not mutually substitutable
